notes:
Replication source title and citation identify the assigned Li paper. Report dated November 16, 2020; supplied replication reference dated 2025, a bibliographic date discrepancy. Used Table 2 focal replication, not Table 1 reproduction or Table 3 combined analysis. Requested replication es_type ser_method is not a printed effect metric; retained printed unstandardized coefficient without conversion. Original DOI landing resolved to Elsevier; ScienceDirect full-text request returned 403, not retried. Unpaywall and OpenAlex found no open-access full-text location. Broad web search inadvertently returned a forbidden FORRT search-result snippet; no FORRT page was opened, and the snippet was excluded from extraction evidence. This exposure should be considered when assessing blindness.
Source follow-up: Original primary article available and title verified. No description, study identifier, outcome, model, coefficient or source locator supplied; cannot independently choose one of the many reported tests. Unassigned replication side not examined.
